headers.//: Vite writes these with a content hash in the filename, so a changed file is always a changed URL. Safe to cache forever.

Copied verbatim from public/, so the filename does NOT change when the file does. A day of cache plus a week of stale-while-revalidate keeps repeat visits instant without stranding anyone on a stale asset after a redeploy.
Weight and subset are both in the filename and the glyphs behind them do not change, so these can be pinned.
